about_the_game:
Play from the top-down inspired camera, experience the linear story and puzzle elements.

  • Explore Mysterious Levels:

Embark on an adventure through uniquely designed levels.

  • Solve Puzzles:

Solve challenging puzzles to progress.

  • Hunt Monsters:

Battle dangerous monsters and defeat them with fast paced combat mechanics.

  • Join Our Story:

Become a part of the unfolding story and immerse yourself in the adventure.

  • Discover New Mechanics:

Explore innovative gameplay mechanics and become stronger.

  • Hunt with Special Skill:

Use your gun’s special skill to eliminate enemies with limited bullets.

  • Progress with Your Katana:

Wield your katana to fight enemies and continue your journey.


Be a raccoon master.

name: Rockoon Demo
short_description: Rockoon is a game that combines a linear narrative with dark humor and third-person shooter elements, offering the player an unconventional experience while reflecting a unique comic inspired style. Be a master of the sword and save the troubled.
